snippet.title: Echo Weaver | Official Release Date Announcement | All Platforms
snippet.description:
Get the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/?utm_source=agyoutube

If you miss the unforgettable feeling of solving Outer Wilds or mastering Tunic, you need to put Echo Weaver on your radar immediately. This isn't your standard 2D platformer—it is a brilliant time loop Metroidbrainia where traditional gear doesn't exist. Secrets are your upgrades, and knowledge is your only progression.

You play as the last of the Weavers, waking up with no memory in the glitching, ruined utopia of Provenance. Every time the clock runs out, the world resets. But here is the twist: your character can already do everything required to beat the game—you just don't know how to do it yet. By exploring stunning biomes, interacting with bizarre survivors (like a sentient corporate AI cat), and unearthing hidden Echo Rifts, you will piece together the mechanics needed to rewrite the timeline.

No hand-holding. Just pure, satisfying discovery and precision platforming. Watch the gameplay to see how we manage time as a literal currency, map out flawless routing, and manipulate the environment to turn this digital prison into salvation!

Coming October 8 to all platforms. Day One on Xbox Game Pass.

To learn more about Akupara Games and Moonlight Kids:
►Akupara Games: https://linktr.ee/akuparagames
►Moonlight Kids: https://www.moonlightkids.co/

Join the Echo Weaver community in the Moonlight Kids Discord: https://discord.gg/qSGTDRh
